author: William Saville
content:
Shouting and anger,
Full devastation,
On both sides,
Ripping our nation.
Hateful tongues cry for ”family values”,
They deny to others what they hold dear,
Their ignorance disguised by faith,
Their hate and disgust is just concealed fear.
Flags hung and waving,
They consider him ”god chosen”,
Infidelity and fraud,
He considers presidency a promotion.
A failed businessman,
Nothing great about him,
How can they expect him to make our country great,
When he makes choices on a whim.
I’m not saying the democrats,
Are a party to be praised,
Ever since the party switch in 1948,
It has left our country confused and dazed.
So many people are stuck on tradition,
That doesn’t work in modern times,
People are being killed for being themselves,
People that wouldn’t hurt anyone and were in their primes.
So many killings,
So much hurt and despair,
We just want to live authentically,
Why do you even care?
Why is the life of someone dressed differently than YOU’D like,
Trying to volunteer and spread joy,
Deserving of so much hate and derision,
Why do you only think to destroy?
No one is grooming anyone,
We aren’t seeking to turn your children queer,
We just want to protect those that are,
So they don’t have to live with our fear.
Aren’t we supposed to create a better world,
For the next generation,
So they don’t have to suffer like we did,
And provide more and more education?
Authors who’s names are used for schools,
You burn their books and many more,
You seek to destroy what you don’t understand,
Which is the mindset of child of no older than four.
Stop throwing your temper tantrums,
Times are changing and it’s good,
Open a damn book and read,
Remove that white robe and hood.
